title: Mr C Residences picture band
description: A full-bleed image or video band, as tall as the window on desktop (or a wide 1440:753 frame), with tiny white uppercase captions in its bottom corners. The picture is taller than its frame and slides down through it while the band crosses the window, a slow scrubbed parallax.
notes: phones: a 390:293 frame; desktop: the window's height (size 'window') or 1440:753 (size 'wide')
the media fills the frame like object-fit cover; empty, a soft highlight-to-secondary placeholder
the captions are primary-foreground (white) and assume a picture under them
